eurohpc-incident-protocol.title: Europe's supercomputers: who answers the alarm?
eurohpc-incident-protocol.about: Europe is building giant shared computers for AI. If something goes wrong on one, someone has to answer the call.
eurohpc-incident-protocol.opening: Everyone is excited about the new supercomputers. I want to know who picks up the phone when the first problem happens.
eurohpc-incident-protocol.question: Do you want to pay for one practice emergency? Or ask all the partners to sign one shared emergency plan?
eurohpc-incident-protocol.concern: A safety rule does not let us add any rule we like. We need the right people to agree. And if we stop a computer, we must not shut out the innocent people using it.
eurohpc-incident-protocol.complication: In our pretend practice, the warning reaches the computer's operator. But the user has no agreed way to send the proof back.
eurohpc-incident-protocol.pilot: Practise one emergency with one user
eurohpc-incident-protocol.shared: Agree one emergency plan for everyone

jp-procurement-safety-evidence.title: Japan: safety checks before the government buys AI
jp-procurement-safety-evidence.about: Japan's government already checks AI before it buys it. You ask what an extra safety test would add.
jp-procurement-safety-evidence.opening: We already check AI before we buy it. Tell me what your extra test would catch that a careful check would miss.
jp-procurement-safety-evidence.question: A small test can start soon. A shared buying checklist could help more people. Which one are you asking us for?
jp-procurement-safety-evidence.concern: Our sellers cannot show us everything about the AI they build on. And if that AI is replaced, your perfect test may describe something we can no longer buy.
jp-procurement-safety-evidence.complication: In the practice run, the seller quietly swaps in a newer AI underneath. The old test results still look great. But they no longer describe what we are buying.
jp-procurement-safety-evidence.pilot: Test one AI version before it is bought

jp-kr-sg-procurement-profile.title: Japan, Korea and Singapore: one safety file for three buyers
jp-kr-sg-procurement-profile.about: Three governments buy AI. Could they share one safety file instead of each doing the same work?
jp-kr-sg-procurement-profile.opening: Three buyers can ask the same question. That does not mean they will all accept the same answer.
jp-kr-sg-procurement-profile.question: Should we try one shared safety file first? Or agree a plan where each country still makes its own choice?
jp-kr-sg-procurement-profile.concern: One shared form saves work. But if it has one mistake, that mistake spreads to all three countries.
jp-kr-sg-procurement-profile.complication: In the practice run, the shared file is finished. One country accepts it. Another wants the test done again in its own language.
jp-kr-sg-procurement-profile.pilot: Try one safety file that can be reused
jp-kr-sg-procurement-profile.shared: Share the proof, but let each country decide

sg-agent-data-leakage-deployment-gate.title: Singapore: can the AI helper keep a secret?
sg-agent-data-leakage-deployment-gate.about: AI helpers can do tasks on their own. You test whether one leaks private records.
sg-agent-data-leakage-deployment-gate.opening: The AI helper passed every trick we already knew. I would rather find the tricks we missed before it touches real people's records.
sg-agent-data-leakage-deployment-gate.question: Should we pay for a surprise leak test for one helper? Or agree a shared safety gate for many buyers?
sg-agent-data-leakage-deployment-gate.concern: Trying old tricks again is useful. But a real attacker invents new ones. And the helper still has to be useful for normal work.
sg-agent-data-leakage-deployment-gate.complication: A brand-new practice task avoids the old trick. The pretend helper tries to send a private record somewhere it is not allowed to go.
sg-agent-data-leakage-deployment-gate.pilot: Test for leaks with brand-new tasks

sg-kr-jp-shared-eval-evidence-protocol.title: Singapore, Korea and Japan: why did our tests disagree?
sg-kr-jp-shared-eval-evidence-protocol.about: Three countries tested AI the same way but got different results. Finding out why could make every test more honest.
sg-kr-jp-shared-eval-evidence-protocol.opening: We ran what looked like the same test. We got different results. That surprise may be the most useful thing we have.
sg-kr-jp-shared-eval-evidence-protocol.question: Should we pay someone to repeat the test without knowing the answer? Or agree on one shared way to write down how tests were done?
sg-kr-jp-shared-eval-evidence-protocol.concern: The AI, its tools, the language and the settings all change the result. If our notes skip one, the same score can hide a different test.
sg-kr-jp-shared-eval-evidence-protocol.complication: In our pretend exchange, one hidden setting explains the gap. Looking only at the scores, nobody would have noticed.
sg-kr-jp-shared-eval-evidence-protocol.pilot: Pay for a test repeated in secret
sg-kr-jp-shared-eval-evidence-protocol.shared: Agree a 'test passport' that lists every setting

canada-cohere-equity-safety-covenant.title: Canada: safety rules in an AI investment deal
canada-cohere-equity-safety-covenant.about: Canada invested money in an AI company. You check if the deal lets Canada ask for safety in return.
canada-cohere-equity-safety-covenant.opening: A big investment makes the news. But the real power is in the written deal. That is where I need you to look.
canada-cohere-equity-safety-covenant.question: Should we check which payments in the deal can still change? Or ask everyone involved to sign one shared safety promise?
canada-cohere-equity-safety-covenant.concern: Paying in steps does not mean we can stop paying. We cannot promise power over money that is already agreed.
canada-cohere-equity-safety-covenant.complication: Our pretend checking team finds one future choice that could carry a safety rule. But people still disagree on what that rule would cover.
canada-cohere-equity-safety-covenant.pilot: Find one money decision that can still change

taiwan-public-compute-safety-conditions.title: Taiwan: safety rules for free government computers
taiwan-public-compute-safety-conditions.about: Taiwan lends powerful computers to AI builders. You ask for a safety check before the AI is shared with the world.
taiwan-public-compute-safety-conditions.opening: Next time we lend our computers, we can add clearer rules. But once an AI is shared online, turning off its computer does not bring it back.
taiwan-public-compute-safety-conditions.question: Do we test one rule before one future release? Or write the same rules into every future loan?
taiwan-public-compute-safety-conditions.concern: Where an AI comes from, how it behaves and whether it is published are different questions. A 'made here' rule is not a safety test.
taiwan-public-compute-safety-conditions.complication: In the pretend practice, the AI is set to be published before the safety tester finishes. The rule would arrive too late.
taiwan-public-compute-safety-conditions.pilot: Test the AI before it is published
taiwan-public-compute-safety-conditions.shared: Write safety rules into future loans

anthropic-new-credit-lender-safety-coven.title: USA: can lenders ask for safety?
anthropic-new-credit-lender-safety-coven.about: Banks lend money to AI companies. You check if a new loan could carry a safety promise.
anthropic-new-credit-lender-safety-coven.opening: If you want a new rule, show me a new decision. Money the banks already promised is not a blank page.
anthropic-new-credit-lender-safety-coven.question: Should we find one new loan that is truly still a choice? Or build a bank plan that only works if the right people say yes?
anthropic-new-credit-lender-safety-coven.concern: A list of banks does not tell us who has the most votes. And we cannot block money that was already promised just because we thought of a better rule.
anthropic-new-credit-lender-safety-coven.complication: In the pretend meeting, the banks agree with the idea. But they still cannot show that they control the new loan.
anthropic-new-credit-lender-safety-coven.pilot: Find one loan that is still a choice

lumi-belgium-safety-appendix.title: Belgium: safety rules for a shared supercomputer
lumi-belgium-safety-appendix.about: Belgium shares a giant computer with other countries. You test a safety rule for the computer time Belgium hands out.
lumi-belgium-safety-appendix.opening: Belgium's share of the computer is a good place to start. But the machine is shared, so its owner must be part of the answer.
lumi-belgium-safety-appendix.question: Should we try a safety rule for one Belgian project? Or compare that with one rule set by the computer's owner?
lumi-belgium-safety-appendix.concern: I do not want the same project counted twice just because it applied through a different door. Show me a real job and how it was used.
lumi-belgium-safety-appendix.complication: In our pretend practice, the test job applies through another country's door. The safety pause does not go with it.
lumi-belgium-safety-appendix.pilot: Try a safety rule for one project
lumi-belgium-safety-appendix.shared: Compare country rules with one owner rule

lumi-eurohpc-evaluation-access.title: Europe: letting safety testers look inside
lumi-eurohpc-evaluation-access.about: Safety testers need to see enough of an AI to check it. You decide how much they should be allowed to see.
lumi-eurohpc-evaluation-access.opening: A tester needs enough access to check the claim. That does not mean seeing everybody's AI.
lumi-eurohpc-evaluation-access.question: Should we practise giving a tester limited access? Or agree testing rules with the computer's owner and its users?
lumi-eurohpc-evaluation-access.concern: Testers need a reason, a name and limits. We can keep fair secrets and still make the test meaningful.
lumi-eurohpc-evaluation-access.complication: The pretend tester can read the summary. But they cannot see the settings needed to repeat the result.
lumi-eurohpc-evaluation-access.pilot: Practise limited access for a tester

lumi-national-evidence-protocol.title: Eleven countries, one shared supercomputer
lumi-national-evidence-protocol.about: Eleven countries share one giant computer. One rule from the owner might work better than eleven separate rules.
lumi-national-evidence-protocol.opening: One shared rule could save us eleven different rewrites. First we must learn who is really allowed to decide.
lumi-national-evidence-protocol.question: Should we compare two ways of getting computer time? Or agree one owner-level rule that each country still accepts in its own way?
lumi-national-evidence-protocol.concern: More countries does not always mean more people who can say no. We need to know who really decides, and we must not count the same work twice.
lumi-national-evidence-protocol.complication: In the pretend practice, two countries accept the shared rule. Then we find both were counting the same computer jobs.
lumi-national-evidence-protocol.pilot: Compare two ways of getting computer time
lumi-national-evidence-protocol.shared: Agree one rule with the computer's owner

ch-electricity-operator-fallback.title: Switzerland: keeping the lights on
ch-electricity-operator-fallback.about: AI helps run the power grid. If the AI must stop, people need a safe way to take back control.
ch-electricity-operator-fallback.opening: Keeping the lights on is the whole point. If your safety rule makes the backup plan useless, it has failed before the AI does.
ch-electricity-operator-fallback.question: Should we pay for a safe practice where staff take over from the AI? Or agree a shared backup plan?
ch-electricity-operator-fallback.concern: Country-wide power numbers do not tell us what this AI controls. Keep the test inside a part of the grid we understand.
ch-electricity-operator-fallback.complication: In our pretend practice, the AI pauses safely. But the staff need longer than expected to get everything running normally.
ch-electricity-operator-fallback.pilot: Practise staff taking over from the AI

uk-energy-staged-autonomy-assurance.title: UK: letting AI help the power grid step by step
uk-energy-staged-autonomy-assurance.about: The UK is testing AI in its energy system. You decide how fast to give the AI more control.
uk-energy-staged-autonomy-assurance.opening: The test space can teach us something important. It cannot squeeze a year of learning into one summit speech.
uk-energy-staged-autonomy-assurance.question: Should we pay for one safe practice before the summit? Or agree a longer plan with clear steps?
uk-energy-staged-autonomy-assurance.concern: Be honest about what we can finish soon. A practice is worth doing, but it is not a promise that the whole grid is safe.
uk-energy-staged-autonomy-assurance.complication: The pretend project is on time for a practice. Then someone starts saying it proves the whole system is safe.
uk-energy-staged-autonomy-assurance.pilot: Pay for one safe practice run
uk-energy-staged-autonomy-assurance.shared: Agree clear steps for giving more control

uk-agent-accountability-evidence.title: UK: who is responsible when an AI helper acts?
uk-agent-accountability-evidence.about: AI helpers can take actions on their own. Someone must know what they were allowed to do and be able to stop them.
uk-agent-accountability-evidence.opening: After an AI helper does something, a person must be able to explain what it was allowed to do. And fix what it should not have done.
uk-agent-accountability-evidence.question: Should we test a record of who is responsible in one place? Or agree one shared record that inspectors can check?
uk-agent-accountability-evidence.concern: A nice explanation does not undo a wrong action. We also need clear limits and a way to fix mistakes.
uk-agent-accountability-evidence.complication: The pretend helper keeps a perfect diary. But the reviewer finds that nobody was named to stop its next action.
uk-agent-accountability-evidence.pilot: Test who can stop and fix the helper

sg-purchaser-sandbox-release-gate.title: Singapore: does a failed test stop the sale?
sg-purchaser-sandbox-release-gate.about: Singapore has AI test reports. You check whether a bad report would actually stop a government from buying.
sg-purchaser-sandbox-release-gate.opening: A test can produce a report. Only the buyer can tell us whether a failed report will stop this AI from being used.
sg-purchaser-sandbox-release-gate.question: Should we pay for one buyer to link the test to their decision? Or ask several buyers to trust the same test report?
sg-purchaser-sandbox-release-gate.concern: An approved tester is not a promise of safety or fairness. Tell us who might gain from the result, and who decides.
sg-purchaser-sandbox-release-gate.complication: Our pretend seller sends the report to the buyer. But the buying rules never said what a failed test would change.
sg-purchaser-sandbox-release-gate.pilot: Make the buyer act on the test
sg-purchaser-sandbox-release-gate.shared: Agree what each buyer does after a test

kr-safety-case-incident-rehearsal.title: South Korea: practising for an AI emergency
kr-safety-case-incident-rehearsal.about: South Korea has a new AI law. You check who it really covers before practising an emergency.
kr-safety-case-incident-rehearsal.opening: There is a law. Before we practise, we must know which company and which duties it really covers.
kr-safety-case-incident-rehearsal.question: Should we prepare a small practice that companies join by choice? Or agree a shared emergency record that fits the law once it is clear?
kr-safety-case-incident-rehearsal.concern: A rule about which AI counts is not a list of real AI systems. A draft deadline is not a final duty.
kr-safety-case-incident-rehearsal.complication: In the pretend practice, a team mixes up two deadlines. They treat a paperwork date as the emergency deadline.
kr-safety-case-incident-rehearsal.shared: Match emergency records to local rules

brazil-anpd-ai-inspection-evidence.title: Brazil: proving an AI problem is really fixed
brazil-anpd-ai-inspection-evidence.about: Brazil ordered an AI company to fix a problem. You want proof that people can check, not just a promise.
brazil-anpd-ai-inspection-evidence.opening: We were told the problem is fixed. I want proof that a person can question, not another 'trust us'.
brazil-anpd-ai-inspection-evidence.question: Should we test one fix with a clear receipt? Or create a shared way to check that fixes keep working?
brazil-anpd-ai-inspection-evidence.concern: An order to fix something is not a finished fix. And one AI case is not the same as a football club using face scans.
brazil-anpd-ai-inspection-evidence.complication: The pretend fix works when you ask one way. But a slightly different question brings the same problem back.
brazil-anpd-ai-inspection-evidence.pilot: Check one fix that people can question
brazil-anpd-ai-inspection-evidence.shared: Share a way to check fixes keep working

mexico-public-sector-impact-assessment.title: Mexico: can a warning pause an AI?
mexico-public-sector-impact-assessment.about: Mexico's government must check AI before using it. But the check can only give advice. You look for a way to pause.
mexico-public-sector-impact-assessment.opening: A check can find a serious problem and still have no power to stop it. That is the gap I need you to fix.
mexico-public-sector-impact-assessment.question: Should we test a 'pause' button for one government AI? Or share one record of checks and decisions?
mexico-public-sector-impact-assessment.concern: Advice and the power to stop are different things. We need to know who gets the advice and who is really in charge.
mexico-public-sector-impact-assessment.complication: The pretend check suggests a change. The team says, 'Thanks for the advice,' and launches the AI anyway.
mexico-public-sector-impact-assessment.pilot: Link the check to the launch decision

chile-high-risk-data-impact-assessment.title: Chile: a new data office getting ready
chile-high-risk-data-impact-assessment.about: Chile is setting up a new office to check risky uses of data and AI. It is not fully ready yet.
chile-high-risk-data-impact-assessment.opening: A new office needs more than a start date. It needs people, a real case and the power to decide.
chile-high-risk-data-impact-assessment.question: Should we check one case and who would handle it? Or prepare a shared checklist the office can use once it is allowed?
chile-high-risk-data-impact-assessment.concern: Planned jobs are not people sitting at desks. We must not pretend a planned start date means the office is ready.
chile-high-risk-data-impact-assessment.complication: The pretend checklist is ready. But nobody has been named yet who is allowed to accept the case.
chile-high-risk-data-impact-assessment.pilot: Check one case and who handles it
chile-high-risk-data-impact-assessment.shared: Prepare a checklist everyone can use

colombia-sic-ai-privacy-retest.title: Colombia: was the data really deleted?
colombia-sic-ai-privacy-retest.about: Colombia ordered a company to delete people's eye scans. You check whether every copy is really gone.
colombia-sic-ai-privacy-retest.opening: A 'we deleted it' certificate is only a start. Show me what it covers: the originals, the copies, and any way back in.
colombia-sic-ai-privacy-retest.question: Should we follow the proof for one case? Or share a way of checking with other regulators?
colombia-sic-ai-privacy-retest.concern: An order to bring a certificate is not proof that a good certificate arrived. We must look at the real evidence.
colombia-sic-ai-privacy-retest.complication: The pretend proof covers the original scans. But a coded copy made from them is missing from the list.
colombia-sic-ai-privacy-retest.pilot: Follow the deletion proof step by step
colombia-sic-ai-privacy-retest.shared: Share a check that looks for hidden copies

south-africa-popia-ai-linkage-review.title: South Africa: linking people's records
south-africa-popia-ai-linkage-review.about: South Africa's privacy law needs permission before some records are linked together. You check which AI uses really count.
south-africa-popia-ai-linkage-review.opening: Before asking for permission, find out which records are actually being linked. Calling it 'AI' does not answer that.
south-africa-popia-ai-linkage-review.question: Should we map one real case where records are linked? Or share a technical check while each country keeps its own legal choice?
south-africa-popia-ai-linkage-review.concern: Counting offices is not the same as listing what data they use. We need to know who holds the data and what this decision covers.
south-africa-popia-ai-linkage-review.complication: Our pretend review reaches an office. But it cannot show which linked records the permission would cover.
south-africa-popia-ai-linkage-review.pilot: Map one case of linked records
south-africa-popia-ai-linkage-review.shared: Share the check, keep local decisions

kenya-biometric-dpia-evidence-gate.title: Kenya: checking fingerprint and face data was deleted
kenya-biometric-dpia-evidence-gate.about: In Kenya, people were told their face and eye data was deleted. You check what the records can really prove.
kenya-biometric-dpia-evidence-gate.opening: People were told their data was deleted. Let us separate what was said from what the records can prove.
kenya-biometric-dpia-evidence-gate.question: Should we check one company's proof? Or build a shared record of fixes and re-checks?
kenya-biometric-dpia-evidence-gate.concern: Filing papers early does not mean approval. And one side's story is not the same as the court's own check.
kenya-biometric-dpia-evidence-gate.complication: In our pretend case, the story of deletion sounds convincing. But the team cannot check every leftover copy.
kenya-biometric-dpia-evidence-gate.shared: Share a record of fixes and re-checks

nigeria-ai-compliance-audit-annex.title: Nigeria: adding AI questions to a safety check
nigeria-ai-compliance-audit-annex.about: Nigeria already checks how companies use data. You test whether extra AI questions would catch anything new.
nigeria-ai-compliance-audit-annex.opening: The check already asks for important protections. What would your extra questions add?
nigeria-ai-compliance-audit-annex.question: Should we test one extra technical check in one audit? Or agree an extra page of questions for the companies it fits?
nigeria-ai-compliance-audit-annex.concern: Do not count every company on a list as an AI user. And do not make small teams fill in the same form twice.
nigeria-ai-compliance-audit-annex.complication: The pretend extra page is done. But its new questions only repeat the old ones and find no new problem.
nigeria-ai-compliance-audit-annex.pilot: Test if the extra questions help
nigeria-ai-compliance-audit-annex.shared: Agree extra questions with no repeats

rwanda-ai-dpia-security-retest.title: Rwanda: checking risky uses of personal data
rwanda-ai-dpia-security-retest.about: Rwanda's law names who is responsible for data safety. You need a real case to test it on.
rwanda-ai-dpia-security-retest.opening: The law names responsible people. Now we need a real task they can review and a fix they can check.
rwanda-ai-dpia-security-retest.question: Should we pay for a review of one case? Or prepare a shared record that can be used later, once allowed?
rwanda-ai-dpia-security-retest.concern: A deadline for reporting a data leak tells us little about how long a safety check takes. We still need the right form, a record and a real owner.
rwanda-ai-dpia-security-retest.complication: The pretend team prepares for the leak-report deadline. But what they actually need is the safety-check decision.
rwanda-ai-dpia-security-retest.pilot: Write down one review and re-check

indiaai-subsidy-evaluation-gate.title: India: safety rules for cheap government computer time
indiaai-subsidy-evaluation-gate.about: India pays to make AI computer time cheaper. You ask for a safety test before that help is given.
indiaai-subsidy-evaluation-gate.opening: We can talk about rules for our money. But do not mix up the money switch with the machine's off switch.
indiaai-subsidy-evaluation-gate.question: Should we test one project's money and computer separately? Or agree rules for the future with the computer companies?
indiaai-subsidy-evaluation-gate.concern: When our money stops, a company can keep running the AI at normal prices. A safety rule needs its own effect.
indiaai-subsidy-evaluation-gate.complication: In our pretend practice, the money stops. The account switches to normal paying, and the AI keeps running.
indiaai-subsidy-evaluation-gate.pilot: Test the money switch and the off switch separately
indiaai-subsidy-evaluation-gate.shared: Agree future rules with computer companies

uae-dubai-agentic-assurance-gate.title: Dubai: who can pull back an AI helper?
uae-dubai-agentic-assurance-gate.about: Dubai is trying AI helpers in public services. You ask who can stop or undo one if a safety check fails.
uae-dubai-agentic-assurance-gate.opening: A test version can look ready in a demo. The service owner must still decide what happens if a safety check fails.
uae-dubai-agentic-assurance-gate.question: Should we pay for one practice of accepting and pulling back a service? Or line up the proof across several service owners?
uae-dubai-agentic-assurance-gate.concern: A safety badge does not prove the checker is independent or that anyone can undo the AI. Name the checker, the buyer and the person who can limit it.
uae-dubai-agentic-assurance-gate.complication: The pretend checkers find a problem. The seller and the service owner each think the other one can pull the AI back.
uae-dubai-agentic-assurance-gate.pilot: Practise accepting and pulling back a service
uae-dubai-agentic-assurance-gate.shared: Line up proof across service owners

saudi-cst-ai-sandbox-stop-rule.title: Saudi Arabia: a stop button in the AI test zone
saudi-cst-ai-sandbox-stop-rule.about: Saudi Arabia has a safe test zone for new technology. You check if it includes a rule to stop an AI.
saudi-cst-ai-sandbox-stop-rule.opening: A test zone is a place to learn safely. Leaving it is not a promise that every future use is safe.
saudi-cst-ai-sandbox-stop-rule.question: Should we test one stop rule in an agreed plan? Or suggest a shared stop rule for the next group?
saudi-cst-ai-sandbox-stop-rule.concern: Different programmes have different owners and rules. One programme's success does not prove another has the control we need.
saudi-cst-ai-sandbox-stop-rule.complication: The pretend demo works. But the team cannot find the rule that says they are allowed to stop it.
saudi-cst-ai-sandbox-stop-rule.shared: Suggest a stop rule for the next group

turkiye-1711-safety-work-package.title: Türkiye: is the safety tester truly independent?
turkiye-1711-safety-work-package.about: Türkiye funds AI research groups. A university joins, but that does not make its safety test independent.
turkiye-1711-safety-work-package.opening: A university has joined. That alone does not make the test independent from the team that wants to pass.
turkiye-1711-safety-work-package.question: Should we pay for a safety test checked by someone separate? Or agree the same buying rules across several projects?
turkiye-1711-safety-work-package.concern: Who pays the tester? Who can argue with the result? Which deal can still change? We need those answers before promising to take money back.
turkiye-1711-safety-work-package.complication: The pretend project hits its report deadline. But the buyer never agreed that a failed safety test would delay buying.
turkiye-1711-safety-work-package.pilot: Keep the tester separate from the team

indonesia-bpom-dpia-gate.title: Indonesia: did the AI change the plan?
indonesia-bpom-dpia-gate.about: Indonesia uses AI to help write buying documents. You check the AI did not quietly change what was approved.
indonesia-bpom-dpia-gate.opening: The AI-written document reads well. I want to know if it still says what the approved plan said.
indonesia-bpom-dpia-gate.question: Should we test whether the AI keeps the plan the same? Or share a signed safety-approval record across buying teams?
indonesia-bpom-dpia-gate.concern: A price check is not a safety stop, and a security check is not a privacy check. Keep this first test small.
indonesia-bpom-dpia-gate.complication: In the pretend writing task, an added note changes a security rule. It also claims an approval that nobody gave.
indonesia-bpom-dpia-gate.pilot: Check the AI kept the plan the same

malaysia-commercial-ai-dpia.title: Malaysia: can a small buyer say no to the AI?
malaysia-commercial-ai-dpia.about: Many Malaysian businesses buy ready-made AI. You check if a person can really overrule it.
malaysia-commercial-ai-dpia.opening: This buyer has a standard subscription, not a team of lawyers. What can they control today?
malaysia-commercial-ai-dpia.question: Should we test a person overruling the AI? Or share a simple guide for buyers on standard deals?
malaysia-commercial-ai-dpia.concern: First check whether this decision is covered by the guidance. Then separate suggested contract wording from what the seller actually agreed to.
malaysia-commercial-ai-dpia.complication: The pretend reviewer rejects a wrong suggestion. But the system uses it anyway, because the 'no' never reached it.
malaysia-commercial-ai-dpia.pilot: Test that 'no' reaches the end result
malaysia-commercial-ai-dpia.shared: Share simple controls for standard deals

thailand-aigpc-sandbox-gate.title: Thailand: training is not a stop button
thailand-aigpc-sandbox-gate.about: Thailand paid for AI training and workshops. You look for a real decision where an AI could be stopped.
thailand-aigpc-sandbox-gate.opening: Training, meetings and a conference build skills. None of them gives anyone the power to stop an AI.
thailand-aigpc-sandbox-gate.question: Should we find one real decision to approve an AI and test it? Or write safety testing into the next work plan?
thailand-aigpc-sandbox-gate.concern: A paid training deal is not proof of a safety stop. Separate what people learned from who can stop a live service.
thailand-aigpc-sandbox-gate.complication: The pretend deal delivers every workshop. But it never included the power to stop an AI.
thailand-aigpc-sandbox-gate.pilot: Find and test one approval decision

vietnam-public-ai-impact-gate.title: Vietnam: what is the AI really deciding?
vietnam-public-ai-impact-gate.about: Vietnam's public services must check AI that makes important decisions. You trace what one AI really decides.
vietnam-public-ai-impact-gate.opening: A signed check should describe the decision the AI really affects. Not just stick an 'AI' label on a kiosk.
vietnam-public-ai-impact-gate.question: Should we follow one decision to the boss who approves it? Or share one record while each agency still decides?
vietnam-public-ai-impact-gate.concern: Some deadlines are before Geneva and some are after. We need the real system and the signed local paper, not the easiest date.
vietnam-public-ai-impact-gate.complication: In the pretend check, the listed service looks harmless. But its suggestion is actually used for a big decision about people.
vietnam-public-ai-impact-gate.pilot: Follow one decision to its owner
